A '''battle''' took place between the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and forces of the [[Separatist holdouts/Legends|Separatist holdouts]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Diado]] in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]]. It was part of the [[Sy Myrthian Insurrection]], when Imperial forces attempted to drive the remnants of the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Condeferate]] army out of the area around the planet [[Sy Myrth/Legends|Sy Myrth]] and the [[Kreetan Narrows]] region after the Confederate's defeat during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] at the hands of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] that preceeded the Empire. The Imperial [[Twelfth Army/Legends|12th Sector Army]], under the command of [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Adar Tallon/Legends|Adar Tallon]] and [[General/Legends|General]] [[Jan Dodonna/Legends|Jan Dodonna]], defeated the forces of the Separatist holdouts at Diado. Following the battle, the Imperial forces proceeded to emerge [[Battle of Metalorn (Imperial Period)|victorious]] on the world of [[Metalorn/Legends|Metalorn]] as well.<ref name="Warfare" />

==Behind the scenes==
The battle was first mentioned in [[2012]]'s ''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]'', an extensive [[Star Wars: Essential Guides|guide]] dedicated to the conflicts in the [[Galaxy/Legends|galaxy]], written by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Paul R. Urquhart]].<ref name="Warfare" />
